site.title: Facebook
site.short_description: Pages, profiles, posts, and comments for brand visibility.
site.long_description: Facebook Pages can show a website in About and in posts. Confirm rel on the public Page URL. See Create a Page.

opportunities.title: Create Facebook Page with website
opportunities.description: Set up a Facebook Page and add your primary website in About before you post link updates. Facebook typically nofollows outbound links, including Page website fields.

steps.body: Use a Facebook Page for your brand (not only a personal profile).
steps.title: Create or claim a Page

steps.body: Open Page settings → About and enter your site URL in the Website field.
steps.title: Add your website in About

steps.body: Publish changes and confirm the link works from the public Page view.
steps.title: Save and verify

opportunities.title: Personal profile link
opportunities.description: Use your main personal Facebook profile, the account you post from as yourself, and add your site in Intro or the website field on your profile when Meta shows it. Good for founders who want one handle for you and your project. Value is clicks and discovery.

steps.body: Log in at facebook.com, open your personal profile (not a Page), and choose Edit profile or Edit details.
steps.title: Open your personal profile

steps.body: Add your URL in Website or your intro text once, save, and confirm on your public profile view.
steps.title: Add your link

opportunities.title: Facebook Page post
opportunities.description: After your Page lists your website, publish or schedule a Page post with a link preview. Link previews in posts are nofollow from facebook.com.

steps.body: Finish Page About with your website URL before posting external links.
steps.title: Confirm Page setup

steps.body: Write a short update with context and the URL you want to promote.
steps.title: Draft the post

steps.body: Post immediately or schedule for when your audience is most active.
steps.title: Publish or schedule
